purpose: Files that still start captured subprocesses whose failure keeps no reason. This is a ratchet: a file may only shrink or leave, and a file absent from this list may not appear with a violation. Clearing an entry means converting its call sites to carry stderr into the raised error.
why: A captured subprocess that fails reports only an exit status. In this repository that cost six release runs of guessing before the real cause appeared. See docs/maintainer/observation-integrity.md.

entries.reason: HEAD probe: a git failure is folded into the same None as 'this is not a git checkout', so a real checkout with a broken repo would silently get a catalog with no revision. Separating those two outcomes makes the build abort instead of continuing, which is a behaviour change in a build script and waits on a maintainer decision
Same shape as build_catalog.py: rev-parse failure returns None rather than raising, and whether the build should abort there is a behaviour decision, not something this check may make on its own
